match.title: Kenya U23 vs Ivory Coast U23 AFCON U23 Qualifiers 3D Soccer Pitch Graphics Analysis

footage.rights: Used with the permission of the rights holder.
footage.method: Events placed from the main broadcast camera to within about 5 m.

coordinates: x from the left goal line (0-105), y from the near touchline (0-68). Kenya attack toward x = 0. t is match clock in seconds.

sequences.title: Kenya 1–0
notes: Throw-in to goal in about 10 seconds. The far-side carry covered roughly 21 m before the cross went in.
The first cross was cleared only as far as the edge of the area, and Kenya had a player placed there for the second ball.
The shot came from about 18 m with two opponents inside 5 m. By position this is a low-quality chance, so credit the strike.

events.note: Struck from the edge of the area after Kenya won the second ball.

sequences.title: Kenya box entry
notes: Same far-side channel as the opening goal: a 28 m carry, then a drive into the area.
The run ended in a challenge about 13 m from goal with no shot taken.
Support runners are not visible in the highlights frame. Check the full match tape for the cut-back option.

events.note: Challenge inside the area, two players go down. No shot.

sequences.title: Ivory Coast 1–1
notes: Conceded from a switch of play. One diagonal of about 49 m moved the ball from the far side into the near channel.
The wide carry ran about 27 m to the byline with a single defender tracking.
The cross found the far side of the area, behind the ball-side defenders. Far-post marking is the coaching point.

events.note: Switch from the far side into the near channel.
Finish from the far side of the area, arriving behind the ball-side defenders.

sequences.title: Kenya 2–1
notes: The winner came 5 seconds after a regain by the near touchline (tackle at 83:26, shot at 83:31).
Kenya lost the take-on on that side at 83:17 and won the ball back 9 seconds later, high up the pitch.
No. 17 carried about 10 m into the area with three opponents inside 5 m before finishing.

events.note: High regain by the near touchline.
Finish from inside the area after the regain.

sequences.title: Kenya ball claimed
notes: A through ball from about 32 m out ran through to the goalkeeper, who claimed it 6 m from goal.
Possession was returned to Ivory Coast with the lead at one goal in added time.
Suggested discussion: when to play forward and when to keep the ball late in a one-goal game.
